content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creator-built-payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-3|COREMERCH guide to creator]]s in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for payments, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-every-detail-you-4|Automated Digital]]-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-payment-what-actually-14|automated]] delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-every-detail-you-4. content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after a crypto payment is a streamlined process that eliminates the need for traditional payment processors. Instead of relying on platforms like Gumroad, which charges up to 10% per sale, creators can utilize a sovereign infrastructure that leverages NOWPayments for just a 0.5% fee. This model not only reduces costs but also gives complete ownership of the sales process to the creator, ensuring they retain all profits from their work. By using this method, creators can cater to a global audience while avoiding the pitfalls of conventional payment systems.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind automated ebook delivery involves several layers of technology that work seamlessly together. First, creators host their digital products using free services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. When a customer makes a payment through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, a webhook triggers the delivery process. This is managed by backend logic constructed with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, ensuring that customers receive their ebooks instantly after payment confirmation. This infrastructure is not just about automation; it’s designed for sovereignty, allowing creators to control everything from hosting to payment processing.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically engineered for digital creators in regions where payment platforms are either restricted or non-existent. It caters to writers, educators, and designers in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela who seek to sell products such as ebooks, templates, and courses without incurring high fees or facing payment failures. By offering a reliable and affordable alternative, this infrastructure allows creators to focus on their work and sustain their business without being hindered by traditional payment system limitations.
Automated delivery eliminates waiting times for customers.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this automated delivery system include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for crypto transactions, and Google Sheets or Supabase for order management. Each component plays a critical role: hosting provides a stable platform for product display, crypto payment processing ensures low fees and instant transactions, and order management systems keep track of sales without the need for complex databases. Together, these elements create a cohesive system that empowers creators to operate independently and efficiently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement this automated ebook delivery system, start by selecting your hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing, ensuring you configure the webhook for automatic delivery. Create a Google Sheet or use Supabase to manage orders, linking it to your payment processor. Finally, upload your ebooks and test the entire process to confirm that payments trigger delivery correctly. For those seeking a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates for successful deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Retain more of your profits with lower fees from NOWPayments.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
